SydneyDelivery, set-up & collection

Everlit Events hires giant light-up letters, numbers and symbols across Sydney. Every piece is 1.2 metres tall with white LED bulbs and costs $99 per hire, with a two-piece minimum and discounts from four pieces. Two full sets of A–Z and 0–9 mean any name, word or date is possible, in large letters big enough to read across a room. People also call them marquee letters or letter lights; if you want to hire light up letters, or searched light up letters for hire, these are the same pieces. Other names for them are marquee lights, light letters and letters in lights. If you searched party lights hire, party prop hire or event decor hire in Sydney, these giant letters are that piece: a lit-up prop and the decor in one. We are based in Lidcombe and deliver, set up and collect.

How it works

How hire works: delivery, set-up and collection

Tell us the word, date and suburb

Use the builder for an instant price or send a quote request with at least one week's notice. We confirm availability the same business day and hold the pieces with a 30% deposit.

FAQ

Light-up letter hire questions

Looking for something else? We have more questions answered on the FAQ page, and ideas & guides for planning.

How much does it cost to hire light-up letters in Sydney?

$99 per 1.2m letter, number or symbol for the event day, with a minimum of two pieces. Four to six pieces are 10% off, seven to nine 15% off, and ten or more 20% off. Delivery, set-up and collection is a separate fee by zone, from $90 in Western Sydney to $160 on the North Shore and Northern Beaches.

How tall are the letters?

Every letter, number and symbol is 1.2 metres tall, so any combination lines up in one row. Widths run from about 35 cm for an I to about 90 cm for an M or W, and each piece weighs around 7 kg.

Do you have two of each letter?

Yes. We hold two full sets of A–Z and two of 0–9, plus a heart, ampersand, hashtag, @ and ring. Names with a repeated letter and two bookings on the same night are both covered. A word that needs three of one letter can be arranged on request.

Which suburbs do you deliver to?

All of Greater Sydney from our base in Lidcombe: Western Sydney, the South West, the Hills, the Inner West and CBD, the Eastern Suburbs, the North Shore and Northern Beaches, and the Sutherland Shire and St George. We deliver within about 55 km by road of Lidcombe.

Can the letters go outdoors?

Yes, on a flat, dry surface. The letters are not waterproof, so in wet weather they go under a roof, pergola or marquee. The bases are weighted for lawns and terraces, and we bring levelling blocks for uneven ground.

Do they need power?

Yes. Every display needs one standard power point within 5 metres. We bring the leads, the bulbs are white LEDs, and a whole display draws less than a kettle. Every unit is electrically tested and tagged, and the bulbs stay cool to touch.

How long is the hire period?

Standard hire is your event day. We set up one to three hours before guests arrive and collect the same night or the next morning. A weekend hire (Friday to Monday) is 1.5 times the event-day price and a full week is 2.2 times.

How do I book?

Send us the word, the date and the suburb. We confirm availability and an exact price the same business day, and a 30% deposit, paid by card through a secure Stripe link, holds the pieces. The balance and a $200 refundable bond are due seven days before the event. You can get a quote online at any time.

How much notice do you need to book?

Please allow at least one week's notice. That gives us time to confirm the pieces for your date, book the delivery slot for your zone and agree a set-up time with you or your venue.

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard hire is your event day. We set up one to three hours before guests arrive and collect the same night or the next morning. A weekend hire (Friday to Monday) is 1.5 times the event-day price and a full week is 2.2 times.

mainEntity.name: How much notice do you need to book?

acceptedAnswer.text: Please allow at least one week's notice. That gives us time to confirm the pieces for your date, book the delivery slot for your zone and agree a set-up time with you or your venue.
